INTERNSHIP
PROGRAM AT
IIT ROORKEE

IIT Roorkee is organizing institute-funded SPARK fellowships
for internships with a weekly stipend of ₹3000/week

P
rogram
Objectives



To provide research exposure and nurture talented undergraduate students across India.

To attract and encourage SPARK alumni to apply for higher studies at IIT Roorkee.

E
ligibility
Criteria



Students who are currently enrolled and have completed
at least two semesters of the undergraduate degree
(B.Arch./B.E./B.Tech./BS-MS/M.Sc) in a relevant discipline
from any institute in India.

Following minimum CGPA criterion will apply:

CGPA ≥ 7.5 for IITs / IISc.
CGPA ≥ 8.0 for NITs / IISERs / NISER.
CGPA ≥ 8.5 for students of other institutes.
G
uidelines



Please login to submit your application and view status of your application.
Applications need to be submitted through an online portal made for the purpose where the applicants will upload the last semester marksheet of current degree, photograph, a 250-word research statement, and a brief 1-2 page resume. For students of other institutes, No Objection Certificate (NOC)will also be sought on joining.
Applicants need to mention names of five faculty members of their choice from the list of faculty members interested in having a summer intern......
